headline: Frontline Clashes Shift to Weathered Expanse and Stlican Shelf
war_summary: Combat across the northern frontier remained ferocious over the past three hours, though tactical movements shifted as Marban Hollow fell quiet with no base transfers recorded in the latest two-hour window. Weathered Expanse maintained relentless attrition, registering two additional base changes and over fourteen hundred combined casualties in two hours. Nevish Line similarly endured severe fighting, absorbing over fifteen hundred losses in the same span alongside a recent base shift at Princefal. In Kuura Strand, infantry engagements yielded three base transitions within two hours despite comparatively subdued casualty rates. Meanwhile, Stlican Shelf re-entered the spotlight with two base flips centered on Breaker Town, accompanied by over five hundred casualties. Heavy attritional grinds persisted without strategic transfers in Callahan's Passage and Linn of Mercy, where combined two-hour casualty counts exceeded eight hundred and thirteen hundred respectively, while southern reserve sectors remained completely tranquil.
